mentions.name: Snap Receipts
mentions.description: This app helps split a single receipt among a group of people: users upload a photo of the receipt after a shared meal, the app parses out the individual items, everyone is assigned what they got, and it calculates who owes what.
mentions.problem: Splitting a receipt among a bunch of people after a group meal is tedious.
mentions.audience: Friends who need to split bills after group lunches or dinners
mentions.source_excerpt:
An app to help you split individual receipts with a bunch of people:

https://demo.snapreceipts.fyi/

Mainly used by my friends right after we have a group lunch or dinner. 
You just upload a pic of the receipt after a meal and it parses out the items. We assign who got what and it calculates who owes what.
